reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the way music transitions in Provincia. Instead of hard cuts, our new system features a seamless crossfade for day, night, title, and combat beds. This means a smoother auditory experience as you build your colony. Check out the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
